theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (xb e : Rn n) (R d : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < R → closedBall xb (4 * R) ⊆ U → ‖e‖ ≤ 1 → d ≠ 0 → |d| < R → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x P Q) U) → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContinuousOn (fun x => Φ x P) U) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 v U → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, a x (fderiv ℝ v x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → ∃ Ψ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ (x : Rn n) (P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), Ψ x P = d⁻¹ * (Φ (x + d • e) P - Φ x P) - d⁻¹ * (a (x + d • e) (fderiv ℝ v (x + d • e)) P - a x (fderiv ℝ v (x + d • e)) P)) ∧ ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball xb (2 * R) → ∫ x in ball xb (2 * R), a x (fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (v (z + d • e) - v z)) x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in ball xb (2 * R), Ψ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)
